title: horn
description: The simplicial set Λⁿₖ obtained from the boundary of the standard n-simplex Δⁿ by removing its k-th face — all faces but one. Whether the missing face can be filled determines the higher-categorical structure. A simplicial set refined by a missing face.

missing-face.description: index k of the removed face; the horn is inner when 0 < k < n, outer otherwise
